Insecure Data Transmission Due to Missing TLS [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-319] on APIGateway, S3Buckets, SageMaker endpoints: Without TLS, data transmitted between components could be intercepted by attackers in man-in-the-middle positions. This includes sensitive training data, model artifacts, and API communications. An attacker positioned between the client and API Gateway could intercept unencrypted traffic containing sensitive ML model data or training datasets.

Insufficient Network Isolation [Spoofing, Information Disclosure, CWE-284] on SageMaker Training Jobs, Model Registry, S3 Buckets: Without proper VPC configuration, services may be exposed directly to the internet or have unnecessary network access between components. An attacker could potentially access SageMaker training jobs or model artifacts directly if network boundaries are not properly configured.

Model Artifact Poisoning via Unsafe Serialization [Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-502] on Model Registry, Model Artifacts S3 Bucket: Python's pickle format can execute arbitrary code during deserialization. If an attacker can modify model artifacts, they could inject malicious code. An attacker uploads a poisoned model artifact that executes malicious code when loaded by the model serving infrastructure.

Unauthorized Model Artifact Access [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-306] on Model Artifacts S3 Bucket, IAM Roles: Without proper IAM controls and bucket policies, model artifacts could be accessed or modified by unauthorized parties. An attacker gains access to valuable ML models by exploiting overly permissive bucket policies or IAM roles.

Training Data Privacy Breach [Information Disclosure, CWE-359] on Training Data S3 Bucket, SageMaker Training Jobs: Training data containing PII could be memorized by models or leaked through model outputs, leading to privacy violations. An attacker queries the model repeatedly to extract sensitive information about individuals in the training data.

Insufficient High Availability [Denial of Service, CWE-1104] on API Gateway, SageMaker endpoints: Without proper load balancing and DNS configuration, the system is vulnerable to availability issues and DoS attacks. A surge in traffic or targeted DoS attack overwhelms the API Gateway or SageMaker endpoints.

Vulnerable Model Registry [Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-1104] on Model Registry, SageMaker Model: Without proper scanning and validation, vulnerable or malicious models could be registered and deployed. An attacker uploads a model containing known vulnerabilities or malicious code to the registry.
